ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, 'Submitted for Approval'), AND(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, 'Draft'), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)) = 'Submitted for Approval') ), CreatedById <> $User.Id )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the request creator can submit for approval or recall the request.
